plugins.description: Twenty-two skills for animations, shorts and HTML-to-video: low-poly 3D, Minecraft-style voxel builds, 3D cartoon explainers, 2D-in-3D cartoon story shorts (Remotion + three.js), hand-drawn storybook & watercolour 2D animation (node canvas), Kurzgesagt-style flat space, Dan Koe-style line art, stick-figure explainers, minimal steps, 3D map routes, 3D exploded views, line graphs, and the full HyperFrames skill suite.
